defects: Casts `μ.totalVariation s : ℝ≥0∞` to `ℝ` via a bare type ascription `(... : ℝ)`; there is no standard automatic coercion `ℝ≥0∞ → ℝ` in Mathlib (only `ENNReal.toReal` as an explicit function), so this likely fails to elaborate as written

Changes the codomain of the inequality from the extended nonnegative reals (ℝ≥0∞, via `‖·‖ₑ` and the measure-valued `totalVariation`) to the real numbers ℝ with ordinary absolute value, a genuine change of formalization rather than mere notation even though the two are extensionally equal here since totalVariation is always finite
Makes the ambient type `α` an explicit argument instead of implicit as in the gold `{X : Type*}`, altering the call signature
